instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: AgriLink is a medium-sized B2B SaaS provider offering precision farming analytics and IoT integration tools for commercial farms. The company operates within a highly regulated sector due to data privacy concerns and environmental compliance standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have successfully launched three major feature upgrades focused on improving existing user retention through targeted AI recommendations. Our last initiative involved pilot testing a blockchain ledger for supply chain transparency, which required significant internal process changes.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is to achieve diversification by entering adjacent vertical markets such as controlled environment agriculture and sustainable resource management. We aim to establish AgriLink as a leading player in these new areas within the next three years.
answers.teamSize: A focused team of 15 engineers and 5 sales specialists drives our technical roadmap.
answers.additionalContext: The high regulatory environment demands rigorous compliance, which often slows down the deployment of radical new features but also creates barriers to entry for smaller competitors.

opportunities.title: Vertical Pivot into Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging our existing IoT and data processing core, this radical move involves building a completely new SaaS module tailored for high-tech greenhouses. This directly addresses the diversification goal by entering a premium, underserved market.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional task force (Tech + Sales) to define MVP requirements.
Conduct external market validation interviews with CEA farm operators.
resources_needed: Hiring 2 specialized domain experts in CEA technology.
Dedicated budget for rapid prototyping and regulatory consultation.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 paying pilot customers in the CEA sector within 12 months.
milestones: Q3: Finalize technical architecture and compliance roadmap.
Q4: Launch MVP in private beta with initial CEA partners.

opportunities.title: Cross-Sell Suite for Sustainable Resource Management
opportunities.rationale: An incremental opportunity is to integrate modules that address water usage and soil health, allowing us to cross-sell these features to existing commercial farms. This lowers the acquisition cost of new customers while strengthening market presence in related areas.

first_actions: Analyze current customer usage data to identify high potential for resource management features.
Develop a standardized integration API for third-party environmental monitoring tools.
resources_needed: Minor licensing costs for specialized soil science datasets.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average customer feature utilization by 20% within one year.
milestones: Q3: Complete feature development and internal testing.
Q4: Launch integrated cross-sell module to existing client base.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Diversification Task Force' and allocate 20% of the R&D budget to the CEA Vertical Pilot.
Conduct detailed process audit on regulatory compliance bottlenecks to identify areas for automation (efficiency).
Develop a 12-month talent acquisition strategy focused on hiring specialized domain experts in Controlled Environment Agriculture.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on a single, established client segment (lack of diversification).
Slow internal process for integrating new regulatory requirements into the software roadmap.
Limited in-house expertise outside the core precision farming domain.
Culture prioritizing stability over high-risk radical experimentation.
